messages:
incident-bot: Incident detected: increased error rate on /v1/generate (rwd-xl-qa) in us-west-2. Alert: model warmup failures + GPU OOMs. Pager: runtime-warmup-fail.

alex (oncall): I'm oncall — looking now. any customer-reported errors yet?

jordan (support): CC from support, a few customers reported 500s starting ~14:11 UTC. support ticket IDs: #CL-4211, #CL-4212. No P0 escalations yet.

chris (runtime): quick snapshot: we saw a node ramp of container restarts on host gpu-usw2-12 between 14:09-14:13. kube events show OOMKilled during model load, then a compile timeout in the JIT step for the new quantized artifact.

chris (runtime): snippet from model-loader logs:
```
2024-04-12T14:09:58Z model-loader INFO starting warmup for rwd-xl-qa@v12
2024-04-12T14:10:02Z model-loader WARN shard-3 deserialization failed: EOFError("unexpected end of stream")
2024-04-12T14:10:03Z model-loader ERROR failed to allocate GPU memory: cuMemAlloc(0x7f3a) -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
2024-04-12T14:10:04Z runtime compile ERROR kernel selection timed out after 30s
2024-04-12T14:10:05Z container manager INFO container exit code 137
```

priya (sre): thanks. so two separate failure modes colliding: bad shard deserialization (artifact truncated?) plus GPU OOM during warmup compile. may be stampede as many pods tried to load same model after autoscaler bump.

alex (oncall): can we triage scope: is this limited to one node/pool or cross-region?

chris (runtime): currently concentrated in the shared warmup pool (warmup-pool-usw2). other pools look fine. but fallback routing attempted to start more warmup pods which made it worse.

sre-ops-bot: Auto-mitigation: cordon gpu-usw2-12 and drain, created incident-mitigation branch to route traffic away from warmup-pool-usw2 for rwd-xl-qa.

alex (oncall): doing a manual rollback of the recent artifact push to v11 to avoid the corrupted shard. chris, can you confirm v11 is compatible with the running runtime kernel set?

chris (runtime): v11 is fine. also recommending to temporarily disable aggressive compile JIT for that model (set COMPILE_TIMEOUT=0 to force fallback to precompiled kernels) to avoid compile timeouts during warmup.

priya (sre): proposed mitigations (doing in order):
1) Route production traffic to region fallback (us-east-1) for VIP customers, update smart-routing policy to prefer pinned dev variants for low-tier traffic.
2) Rollback artifact to v11 for rwd-xl-qa (alex is on it).
3) Cordon + drain affected node(s) (sre-ops-bot did cordon).
4) Increase warmup backoff + jitter to prevent stampede.
5) Run integrity check on artifact storage for shard corruption.

jordan (support): telling affected customers we're throttling traffic to reduce errors, proactive ticket updates in progress. Customer impact: 4% of requests errored for ~8 minutes, some latencies spiked to 6s.

alex (oncall): rollback to v11 initiated. monitoring patching.

chris (runtime): after rollback and cordon we saw fewer OOMs. runtime logs show warmup successes on replacement nodes but still seeing a handful of deserial errors — likely need to re-upload the specific shard.

chris (runtime): re-upload request queued to artifact-store, requesting checksum from storage team.

sre-ops-bot: Deployed temporary policy: limit concurrent warmup per-model to 2 pods in warmup-pool-usw2.

priya (sre): paging summary for handoff: root cause suspected: corrupted shard artifact combined with aggressive warmup/concurrency causing GPU OOMs and compile timeouts. Primary impact: increased 500s for /v1/generate for rwd-xl-qa, localized to warmup-pool-usw2. Actions taken: rollback artifact, cordon/drain node, throttle warmup concurrency, reroute VIP traffic, scheduled artifact integrity check.

alex (oncall): handing off to priya for overnight monitoring. priya, I'm leaving detailed runbook notes in the incident doc and pinging the storage owner for the shard.

priya (sre): taking it. I'll keep a watch for 2h and escalate if error rate doesn't fall under 0.5% or if restarts resume. Jordan please keep customer comms updated.

jordan (support): will do. posting customer advisory now.

chris (runtime): follow-up TODOs: replace corrupted shard from golden backup, add preflight artifact checksum on upload, add an early-deser healthcheck to reject corrupt artifacts before warmup, consider lowering default warmup concurrency across warmup pools.

priya (sre): tagging incident-severity: sev2 -> monitoring. will update the postmortem template with timeline and attach logs.

alex (oncall): thanks team. if anything spikes ping me directly. :thumbsup:

sre-ops-bot: Incident state changed to MONITORING. Incident lead: priya (sre).
